notes.title: Lily's Handmaid (18+ visual novel) announced on Steam!
notes.content:
Lily's Handmaid is the second visual novel by Arcus Plume. It takes place in the same world as Twin Blue Moons, but features an all-new cast of 9 characters. Lily's Handmaid focuses on relationships between women and includes a large number of (mostly softcore) intimate scenes. Nudity is uncensored by default.

Please note that you have to enable "adult only" content in order to view the store page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1136910/Lilys_Handmaid/
